warnings: No obvious status-quo or baseline alternative was found.
metadata.sampling_design: Stratified scenario allocation with a declared latent-factor Gaussian copula, shared shocks across alternatives, marginal-preserving inverse transforms, and matched independent/correlation-stress counterfactuals.

decision.title: Corporate Finance Capital Allocation
decision.domain: Finance, accounting, valuation, risk management, and capital allocation
decision.owner: Chief financial officer and board finance committee
decision.question: Allocate excess balance-sheet capacity across liquidity, operating investment, acquisition, and shareholder distribution under earnings and credit stress.
blocking_reasons: evidence is not labeled for operational use
decision.feasibility_basis: one-sided 95% upper confidence bound on simulated constraint-breach frequency

retain-liquidity.label: Retain liquidity and refinance
retain-liquidity.description: Preserve cash, retire near-term debt, and delay discretionary investment.

working-capital-platform.label: Working-capital and finance platform
working-capital-platform.description: Invest in receivables, inventory, treasury, and reporting systems with staged operating changes.

acquisition.label: Strategic acquisition
acquisition.description: Acquire a faster-growing adjacent business using cash and term debt.

leveraged-buyback.label: Debt-funded share repurchase
leveraged-buyback.description: Return capital through a debt-funded repurchase while maintaining current operations.

factors.label: Systemic adverse demand and delivery shock
factors.description: A shared latent shock moves outcome distributions across criteria and alternatives in the adverse direction; signs follow each criterion's value direction.

evidence.type: Synthetic financial statements, discounted cash-flow estimates, and stress scenarios
evidence.as_of: Synthetic demonstration; no production as-of date
sources: Illustrative income statement, cash-flow, and balance-sheet forecasts
Synthetic cost-of-capital and covenant stress assumptions
evidence.causal_claim_status: No causal claim; returns, synergies, working-capital effects, and financing costs are scenario assumptions.
limitations: Tax, accounting-policy, and covenant interactions are simplified.
Valuation ranges do not include a full comparable-company or transaction analysis.

decision_notes: A real board paper should reconcile accounting earnings, free cash flow, covenant definitions, tax effects, and valuation assumptions.
